message: Interaction test fails: cabinet_1 hits other_7 while opening. Fix its hinge side, pivot, range or clearance so it can really be used.
Interaction test fails: cabinet_2 hits cabinet_1 while opening. Fix its hinge side, pivot, range or clearance so it can really be used.
Cabinet is too narrow at 2.0 m wide and positioned too far east at x = 0.9 m, leaving a gap on the left where other_5 floats; increase width to about 2.8 m and shift position x to 0.4 m.

Paper trimmer is floating in mid-air above the waste bins at x = -0.55 m because cabinet_1 stops at x = -0.1 m; once cabinet_1 is widened to x = -1.0 m, or shift other_5 east to rest on the counter surface.
Paper shredder is placed at x = -0.65 m where cabinet_1 should extend; shift it about 0.4 m west to sit between the copier and the base cabinet.
Black waste bin is placed at x = -0.2 m where cabinet_1 should extend; shift it about 0.5 m west to sit beside the shredder and left of the base cabinet.
Wall cabinet is slightly too narrow at 2.1 m wide; increase width to about 2.4 m and shift position x to 0.8 m to match the 6-door upper cabinet span.
The east wall entryway is an open glass-partitioned doorway in the footage rather than a solid hinged door panel.
